nom: Lancôme Rose Sugar Exfoliating Face Scrub

avis.texte: I try to keep this stocked in my shower at all times. I use it, at least, once a week and have been doing so for years. It's a bit pricey so I try to stock up during the sales. The scent is nice, the warming feels great and, should you get it in your mouth, it actually doesn't taste terrible.

Oh my goodness . Adding this to my skin care routine . Its warmkng to the face and feels so good no oily residue and leaves you rosy faced . Took off my make up and exfoliated well not being too abrasive
It's not a soapy cleanser. It a oil base cleanser. Didn't cleane the face leaving all make up residue leaving the face uncomfortable dirty and oily skin
This face scrub is very gentle but works so well. I noticed a difference after only one use.
I used this when I took a shower on my face. Sweet smelling & gentle.
It is a great exfoliating face scrub, it leaves your skin very smooth.
I Have been using this scrub for a few years and I love it. Very gentle but still effective in getting rid of dead skin cells and cleaning pores.
I use the whole rose routine. It's luxurious and smells so good.
I bought the Rose Sugar Exfoliating Scrub since my favorite Rose Jelly Mask was discontinued. I do like the scrub and how clean my face feels after using it.

I love the silky skin I get from using this. I use it in the morning to get my nighttime skincare off. I wish it had just a little bit more grit to it but overall it's a great product and I will continue to buy it.

avis.titre: Refreshing to the skin and  Feels like a mini spa
avis.texte: I very much appreciate this product. It "melts" into the skin as it is massaged in. It leaves my face feeling refreshed as it exfoliates the skin, gently removing the dead cells. Feels like the skin of my face is able to breathe again, as silly as that may sound and does so without drying it out!
I love this scrub. There are no microplastics. It feels and smells great. It not only exfoliates, but also softens skin. I use it to clean my face while in the shower.

avis.titre: Love this exfoliating scrub….best I've tried
avis.texte: This is the best exfoliant product I've tried….once I tried the Sugar Rose scrub my search was over….excellent product….highly recommend

I love how smooth this makes my face feel after I use it! And love the way the beads just melt on your skin. It doesn't leave my face feeling dry like other exfoiliants do! This will definitely be the only one I use from now on.
I use this 1-2 times per week in the shower. I use it to gently do a deep cleansing of my face. It leaves my skin feeling clean and smooth.

avis.titre: This product is one of the best product
avis.texte: I've been using this product for three years now and it makes my skin feel so soft reduces my pores, and my skin always has a glow
This scrub is wonderful. I love the scent and the way it makes my face feel afterwards.
I love the lightness of fragrance and gentle exfoliation. I do recommend it.
My favorite exfoliant so far, has helped clear up the blackheads i get along my jaw.
Easy to rinse off, the face does not feel tight after washing
This product is not as exfoliating as its predecessor. Which I preferred.
Absolutely fantastic and it really does help you, no matter your skin type
I'm so pleased I tried this scrub! Just the right amount of scrub and leaves skin so soft ! It feels like you're treating yourself with every use.

Surprisingly warming! I like to use product while showering, so if a little happens to run down onto your mouth, no worries, it's sweet! Wish there was a little more scrub in the product, otherwise, no sensitivity or redness anywhere. Overall good purchase.
It's a good product but it shows my oily face. But not what I expected.
I like how light this scrub is, it helps to make my skin glow.
This scrub is perfect for my skin and the smell is very good too. I love it.

I was looking forward to purchasing this product because I love a good exfoliator. Compared to other brands I was expecting this to be a little more abrasive on my skin and feel like it needs more of the scrubbing bubbles to really get in there. It was a little too soft for being advertised as a "scrub."
I loved this it has a nice subtle rose sent not overpowering.
An amazing product that I will probably use the rest od life :D
I absolutely love this stuff!! the rose sugar is a great medium scrub to soften your skin.

The Rose Sugar Exfoliating Scrub is perfect for me. Exfoliating is so important for weekly maintenance, but this scrub is so gentle I can use it twice a week. It exfoliates, hydrates and brightens my skin but most importantly , it's easy to wash off . You won't find residue on your hands or face after rinsing. I noticed a significant difference after 1 week of use, followed up by Genifique, of course. Definitely a staple in my regimen.
This is a hydrating toner without being irritating or greasy.

Love this face scrub. Gently exfoliating and leaves my skin so soft. Will continue to buy. I have combination skin so relatively dry under eyes and normal cheekbones but oily everywhere else. This is perfect for all areas so should be good for all skin types.
This product gently exfoliates a d has a nice light scent . My face is so soft after using.
I use this scrub 3 times a week to keep my pores clean. I love the smell and it's quite gentle on the skin. I like to stock up when there's a sale!
I love the smell and the way my skin feels after I wash my face. It's the best!!!
the instant warming sensation helps the granules deep cleanse my sking after removing makeup

avis.titre: Makes your face feel new again
avis.texte: I wanted a good face scrub that made my face feel good not raw. This is perfect, the aroma, only use couple times a week. Love it!
This scrub does a great job of clearing my pores but doesn't ash ravage my sensitive skin.
This exfoliator is the most gentle and effective one that I have every used in over 30 years!
One of my all time favorite products EVER! Smells so wonderful and leaves my skin feeling smooth and soft.
Liking it! Using 1-2 a week to maintain healthy looking skin.
Beautiful texture and warming gritty but not harsh feeling on the face with a light rosy scent that leaves my face baby smooth and glowing.

avis.titre: Wonderful product - Use it a few times a week!
avis.texte: Wonderful product that is easy to use. If used regularly, skin becomes smooth and hyperpigmentation lightens. The key is to use it a few times a week.
Smooths out skin without irritating face. Has a grat texture.

I am so happy that i have chosen Rose Sugar Exfoliating scrub . Its the best for cleaning my facial skin and detox it from all the environmental effect. Its so good and worth the money you pay. I use it twice a week
This was my first time trying this product. I purchased it based on other reviews, and I was not disappointed. I will purchase it again.
Refresh and makes my skin feels so good and soft, I love the smell!
The warmth of the scrub feels really good and the fragrance of the scrub is really nice.
This product has been on my reorder list for quite some time now. It helps to take away the dead skin on the face and leave the face a clean and fresh feeling.

avis.titre: Bought to replace other Rose product
avis.texte: I was disappointed to see the other rose product retired. After searching for months for it, I settled on this product. It also seems to work and is easier to apply because I can remove it much faster. Overall happy with the product.

I love this and use it twice a week and depending on the exfoliating my skin needs either use it alone or mix it in with the soft cream face wash. It makes my skin very soft and ready for the next step of moisturizer and allows that to sink in and absorb better.
I use in once in a week. It makes my skin very soft. It smells lovely.
This is one of my favorite Lancome products. It lightly exfoliates, which is perfect for winter dry skin. It also smells amazing! I keep one in every shower.
This is a great exfoliating scrub, wonderful fragrance, leaves your skin feeling wonderful!
Very nice sugar scrub. I like the smell. I got it also for a friend and she loves it too.

I purchased this because the Exfoliance Clarte is no longer available. While this product has a nice smell, I much prefer the other product. The rose scrub is not as 'gritty', if you will, as the previous product was. I don't find it to be as effective.
Smells great. I use about once or twice a week because I have sensitive skin
It's so soft and good to the skin it's actually worth every penny
I use this about once a week to two week for an extra scrub. I don't have to worry about dryness, and I like the smell.
I love this product, my face feels really Clean, especially my pores.
I love the way it makes my face feel. It smells amazing. It lasts a really long time.
I've been using this for years. It's a great exfoliant! Would def recommend!!

avis.titre: Good but I wish you still sold Exfoliance
avis.texte: I like this scrub well enough, but I really miss the Exfoliance.
I love how it exfoliates my skin with out living it dry and rough.
I have mature dry skin and this is a gentle formula to slightly scrub off cream build-up. I use it about every 4 days when I wash my hair.
I have been looking for a very long time for a face scrub that feels great and doesn't dry my skin out… this is it. This is the only one I will use from now on . Thank you
Perfect scrub with a heavenly scent, leaves skin feeling silky

avis.titre: Good product to keep you face smooth
avis.texte: I love this product to make my face feel so smooth and clean. I have very sensitive skin and this is an exfoliating scrub I can use. Highly recommend.
If your face is feeling rough this is your answer. Lightly scrubs the dead skin cells off and leaves your face feeling squeaky clean.

Have used this for quite a while; love the smell and the feel of the scrub. It warms and melts gently as you massage it onto your face. It sloughs off dry, dull skin, and brings fresh clarity and smoothness. Face feels refreshed and soft.

I love this scrub! So many scrubs are harsh and leave your skin dry and tight. This scrub is gentle and leaves your skin feeling soft and silky. The exfoliating properties brighten skin without stripping it. Yay Lancôme!
This product works beautifully! My skin feels so soft after and has a glow.
no es abrasiva y deja la piel muy suave ,la uso una vez a la semana
Leaves my face feeling fresh and supple! I use it every other day.
I am a first time user and I love it! Gentle but effective and smells wonderful.
I love how this sugar scrub cleans the skin, it gives you a real exfoliation

The scent is light and goes on smoothly. It is gently, yet effective. As you circulate and exfoliate, the scrub dissipates as needed. You are left with smooth clean skin. I use it 2-3 times a week in the morning.
Good, I like the quality. It is well made and it cleanses the face well.
It only takes a small drop of this to exfoliate your face and neck.
Love this face scrub - it has a warming sensation and feels amazing!
This rose sugar scrub is really amazing,it's fell your face very smooth and also smelling good!!!!!
This wasn't too harsh compared to other scrubs I tried before. After applying the scrub my skin is soft.
Love the exfoliation, the smoothness of my skin after using this product and it smells wonderful!!!
This works great without irritation. My skin is aging and sensitive, but this doesn't make it worse. I started using it after my chemical peels to keep the great results longer.

avis.titre: Literally my fave I love this product.
avis.texte: This is one of my skin care staples I absolutely love it so much l! I can't reccomend it enough
I use this every day I'm 69 and look like I'm 55 Should always exfoliate
Just enough scrubbing power for a facial polish! Makes you feel fresh and clean
Very nice moisturizer, leave my skin smooth, hydrated, plumped and glowing love it :)
Great exfoliating scrub, leaves face feeling refresh and smooth.

I love the way my skin feels after using the Rose scrub, smooth and it smells great too! I was informed by a Lancome counter specialist not to use this daily (actually not to exfoliate daily, even with my oily skin) and my skin has responded well since I changed my daily routine. I typically use this in the shower, and my skin remains smooth all the way through the prep process. This product has never left my skin dry, even when I was using it daily. I do wish it the product went farther but I am very pleased.
Makes skin soft and feels fresh after using this scrub. Also very gentle to dry skin.

This sugar scrub is a luxurious treat. I put a little warm water on my face and neck, then gently rub the product on. It smells like roses, and it has a gentle warming sensation that feels so nice. When I rinse it off, my skin feels smooth and soft, and stays glowing. I don't need to apply moisturizer like I normally do with a different cleaner or foam. This is a winner all the way, and it's not even expensive. It makes a beautiful gift for someone too.
Excellent for sensitive skin . I exfoliate everyday. Leaves my skin smooth.
Just started using this product and already noticed a difference in my skin.
I wouldn't spend my money on this product. I feel like it works like any scrub I've used in the past.
I buy this item twice a year for my teenage daughter. It works perfectly with her oily skin, no concerns. Love the smell of the scrub
Over all I enjoy the product, but I wish it would exfoliate more. It clean well, but doesn't really get much dead skin off.
I use this scrub several times a week. Love how it warms up and exfoliates very gently. Has a great smell and makes my skin feel awesome afterwards.
i am in absolutely love with this scrub i use it every other day and it feels so good after washing. face with this scrub.
I love this face scrub! The smell, the warming feeling when apply it and the results ! My skin is so radiant after every time I use it!

J'adore ce produit! I love this scrub. It helps all my other skin care product work better. By removing any dead skin cells from the top layer of skin, this helps products absorb better. It makes my skin feel so smooth and clean! I use it anytime I hae a special occasion so my makeup goes on smooth, well moisturized skin. It makes my skin glow!
